title: Lead Me to the Rock

questions.question: Hear my cry, O God, listen to my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:1 (ESV): "Hear my cry, O God, listen to my prayer;"

questions.question: From the end of the earth I call to you when my heart is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:2 (ESV): "from the end of the earth I call to you when my heart is faint."

questions.question: Lead me to the rock that is higher than whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:2 (ESV): "Lead me to the rock that is higher than I,"

questions.question: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:3 (ESV): "for you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the enemy."

questions.question: Let me dwell in your tent when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:4 (ESV): "Let me dwell in your tent forever!"

questions.question: Let me take refuge under the shelter of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:4 (ESV): "Let me take refuge under the shelter of your wings!"

questions.question: For you, O God, have heard my vows; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:5 (ESV): "...you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name."

questions.question: Prolong the life of the king; may his years endure to all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:6 (ESV): "...may his years endure to all generations!"

questions.question: May he be enthroned forever before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:7 (ESV): "May he be enthroned forever before God;"

questions.question: Appoint steadfast love and faithfulness to watch over whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:7 (ESV): "Appoint steadfast love and faithfulness to watch over him!"

questions.question: So will I ever sing praises to your name, as I perform my vows when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:8 (ESV): "...as I perform my vows day after day."

questions.question: What instrument is mentioned in the title of Psalm 61?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61 Title: "To the choirmaster: with stringed instruments. A Psalm of David."

questions.question: The psalmist calls God a strong tower against what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:3 (ESV): "...a strong tower against the enemy."

questions.question: Where does the psalmist wish to dwell?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:4 (ESV): "Let me dwell in your tent forever!"

questions.question: From where does the psalmist call to God?
questions.explanation: Psalm 61:2 (ESV): "from the end of the earth I call to you..."

key_verse_text: From the end of the earth I call to you when my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I,
